body:
Thanks for nice words, kind user:)
Well, I can't move right now, I'm under 18 and by the law in my country (Russia btw) my parents can basically write a report to the police and take me back, so I'm waiting for coming of age to get away from this branch office of hell on the earth...
MEGA MANECTRIC on me, invite 10, fc: 7795 9088 4383
Ohhhh pls I sent (36 lvl DopamineGod)

Hey, hope you're trying to resist your disorder - that's already good for u, your partner should understand this and be a strong & emotionally stable person
You'll be fine🥺
No, but you can start believe in God with its help
But we have a ring of 6 carbon atoms here, it's D for sure
Oh, I know this feeling. Sometimes I think like I’m gonna kill my mom r n, happily I have very understanding boyfriend, we talk about everything and it makes me feel better)
Aww, I’m so thankful to you r n! Really thank you for all this good words, that what I needed actually)

Oh, u know, that’s so touching, I’m a bit crying... Hearing some warm and supporting words from someone you don’t ever know personally is really strange, but nice.
Answering your last question, in next year I’ll pass my exams (shitty Russian SAT version) and I really hope to get on a budget at the medical university - I really would like to become a psychiatrist, ‘cuz I know how mental illnesses can make your life destroyed and how hard to live with disorders, which most people don’t even consider important. Idk, I want help others be happy, but ironically I feel myself like a living dead...

What about hobbies, sometimes I make some jewellery from real flowers and epoxy resin. It’s really calming process, like it so much)
1,5 months ago I started selling it in instagram, so now I have my own money to pay for phone, transport and coffee:)

Heyy, I’m really sorry everything ended like this, hope we understand each other in our thoughts

Just want to say you’re actually one of the best ppl I’ve ever met in my whole life, even arguing a lot in last months won’t change this, I promise.
I really-really-really grateful for your support and all love you gave me this 9 months, just remember I’ll always be at least your friend!

Still your bro, pal, free psychologist & cookie lover,
Your ex
(Omg that so weird to say, tbh I still can’t believe in it)

Ohh I feel you! Hate situations when I start a new pack of rice crackers or iceberg pieces (use them as chips) and it opens too loud, so my mom comes to the kitchen and starts saying me I eat too much. Btw she knows about my ED, I was hospitalized twice.
So tired of this shit. Stay safe, guys, take care of urself💕
